answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The zenith lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the relic is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The design leans on invitation quota tree, converted to a slow vesting stream, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. By the echo of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
